name: Do custom doors improve home security?

mainEntity.name: Do custom doors improve home security?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, custom doors can significantly improve home security, often exceeding the security provided by standard, mass-produced doors. Because they are built to exact specifications and installed with precision, custom doors minimize vulnerabilities like gaps and ill-fitting frames. You also have the option to choose enhanced security features, such as multi-point locking systems, stronger door materials like solid core wood or steel, and reinforced frames. For example, installing a custom-fitted, solid steel entry door with a heavy-duty lockset offers a higher level of protection than many standard options, making your home more secure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom doors improve security through precise fit, minimized vulnerabilities, and optional enhanced features like multi-point locks and stronger materials.
